password.text: Use the employee self-service password reset page. Never send your password or verification code to support. If self-service fails, contact Service Desk.

vpn.text: Check VPN service status first. If operational, reconnect using the approved VPN client and complete the sign-in prompt. If these steps fail, route a ticket to Network Support. No resolution-time guarantee is published.

software.text: Approved software requests require manager approval and a Software Support ticket. This assistant cannot install software or grant administrator rights.
